Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a military family assistance program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing a military family assistanceprogram; adding new sections to chapter 43.330 RCW; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Members of the Washington national guard arecurrently serving to protect the security and wellbeing of the UnitedStates. However, as they are carrying out these duties, many of theirfamilies are left without the adequate means to provide for theirsecurity and wellbeing.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.330 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) There is established in the department a military familyassistance program. The legislature intends that, to the extent ofavailable funds, the program shall be available to provide temporaryfinancial assistance to families with members currently serving in theWashington national guard whose gross family income at time ofapplication does not exceed one hundred fifty percent of the federal p. 1 HB 2873poverty level as adjusted for household size and determined annually bythe federal department of health and human services. (2) The department shall grant assistance to as many applicants aswill utilize available funds less appropriate administrative costs ofthe department, not to exceed five percent of moneys appropriated tothe military assistance program.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.330 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department may receive such gifts, grants, and endowments frompublic or private sources as may be made from time to time, in trust orotherwise, for the use and benefit of the purposes of this chapter andexpend the same or any income therefrom according to the terms of thegifts, grants, or endowments.
